name: Reverse Lunge

instructions.description: Stand upright with feet hip width apart and hands by your sides or on your hips.
Step one leg backward and lower both knees until the front knee is bent and the back knee moves toward the floor.
Keep your torso tall and the front knee aligned over the middle of the foot.
Exhale as you drive through the front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions per side or alternating.

variations.variationDescription: Uses a split stance and greater single-leg control than the bilateral squat.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Keep the feet in a fixed stance to simplify balance demands.

commentsNotes: Take a long enough step back to avoid the front knee traveling excessively forward.
Use support if balance is limited.
